notes.title: Valentine's Patch
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26417922/41a5f086986bceb4d91da5fcf062d61a58e4678a.png
Patch notes 13th February 2017
* Four brand new Show Jumping courses have been added
* Color variations have been added to the show jumps, and to the agility obstacles. These have also been added to Course Editor (The course routes stay the same)
* Show jumping obstacles will now be able to be filtered by jump height in Course Editor
* Grid lines have now been added to the floor in Course Editor scenes to aid placement of obstacles. You can turn this on or off via a button in the top left corner of the Course Editor screen.
* A few more course quests have been added for level 60 players
* All brand new players from the time of this patch, will now receive a 3 day (72 hour) free pass to be a Pro Rider to welcome them to the game. A countdown timer will show time remaining under the horse stats.
* Implemented a game news section so that you can see updates, patch notes etc from within the game
* Implemented a function so that your audio and graphic settings will (hopefully!) not reset to default after an update to the browser version of the game (Facebook and Vkontakte)

notes.title: Patch notes 17th January 2017
notes.content:
Hi everyone :)
Just a small update to address a few things.

* An option has been added to the tutorial scene when you first start playing, this will allow access to the settings menu so that players may adjust settings there before starting the game.
* Weather particles have now been turned off on the High Performance setting to aid those who have performance issues
* The horse is no longer sunk up to the fetlocks in the main menu, the change horse/avatar screen, or the view profile screen
* An option to give a “like” to a player made course is now implemented into the results screen.
* The automatic spam filter has been extended to using more than 5 of the same character in a row from 3.
* The upgrade levels in your inventory list now show correctly from 1 to 6 instead of 0 to 5
* A confirmation pop up has been added when you click to buy a slot in the Course Editor feature.

notes.title: Christmas Patch December 2016
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26417922/ed830125c4ac1fa06e947c0218aa5da31d5c10de.jpg

This patch sees some important news about our Cross Country Kickstarter campaign, as well as some major changes to the shop layout, quests and matchmaking.
There is also important information about Pro Rider subscriptions on Steam. 

Cross Country
Our Kickstarter campaign has now been approved, yay! :) This will hopefully enable us to raise the remaining funds needed to make this long awaited feature. We know how much you really want Cross Country in the game, and we do too. So even if you can’t donate, you can still help enormously by sharing our Kickstarter page https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/artplant/cross-country-feature-for-riding-club-championship 

Shop
* You are now able to preview the avatar in the shop and try items before you buy them
* You are now able to preview the horse in the stable and try items before you buy them
* Items you already own will be at the top of the list with a relative icon so that you may equip and preview it with other items you are thinking of buying
* If you have an item that can be upgraded, that will be shown with an “up arrow”
* To preview an item, click the coat hanger item
* To purchase an item, click the shopping trolley icon
* Items can be filtered by, hats, boots, consumables, saddles etc
* A free Santa hat is available in the shop

Quests - New system
One new quest will arrive every day (together with the daily login), but only if you have a quest slot available. If you already have 3 active quests, then the new quest arriving will simply be lost.
Quests have no expiration, and the only reason to complete them fast is to make sure you have room for new ones. When a quest is completed, they give you rewards. You can not pay to bypass quests anymore. However, you can decline one quest per day, which makes it disappear.
The game will choose a challenge appropriate to a player’s level. In some cases, several challenges will be appropriate, in which case the game chooses one at random.
* We have set you up with a few small quests, just to get you all going
*Jump obstacle quests are no longer able to be completed by using player made courses. Only official courses and obstacles in the paddock will complete these.

Matchmaking
The thing to bear in mind when playing Ranked Matches, is that the system can only select players that are online and actively searching for matches. 
However, the system will now try to match players up by level rather than skill. It will expand the search if there are no players at your level searching at the same time. So, although there will still be times when higher level players and lower level players will get matched together, this should be much less frequent now.

Stable Clubs
* We heard what you said about the notifications in Stable Club chat being intrusive, so you can now disable the match notification messages in Stable chat, and also hide match news in the News section.
* Your Stable Club can now choose a cool icon to replace the default one to display in the ladder and in the club information.
* Members will now be listed in rank order.

Pro Rider accounts on Steam
* Steam will now automatically renew your pro rider subscription each month.
** Please note, that it is your responsibility to ensure any subscription is cancelled to stop any further charges should you wish to discontinue with the subscription.
* To cancel any subscription, you need to go to your store, and purchase history https://store.steampowered.com/account/ There click on “Manage Subscriptions” 
* Please be aware that if you cancel your subscription, you cannot reactivate it until your existing one runs out
* If you experience any difficulties with your subscription, please send these with your Steam name and ID to ridingclubteam@gmail.com along with a copy of the receipt for your subscription. Subscription queries cannot be dealt with on the Forums

Other information
* The main menu inventory has been remade to match the new shop design
* The 1.20 and 1.40 red parallel obstacles now correctly have a red flag on the right side of the fence
* Rectified a bug where some players were getting stuck in the end screen after a match finished if they were afk and did not play the match.
*The name of the course being played will now be permanently displayed at the top of the screen

We’d like to take this opportunity to thank all of you for your continued support, and wish you all a very Merry Christmas, and a happy and prosperous New Year! :)

notes.title: Season 2 of Riding Club Championships - Stable Clubs!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26417922/23a0680bae99dd3161941d4192136be0a12b1afc.png

Patch Notes - Please read carefully as there are some important changes

We have had suggestions from you asking for clubs or guilds to be part of the game, so, as the point of Riding Club is competition...  here it is :)

You can now create, or ask to join a Club, and have up to 20 members with your own private chat room. Clubs will consist of a Stable Owner (the creator) and up to 19 other members. Owners are able to promote any member at any time to be a Club Manager/s who can add and remove players. So you could create a club with just your friends, with players you want that you know are competitive, or your fellow countryfolk, the choice is entirely yours.

* The Stable Club button in the menu will show an alert for a Club notification.
* In the Stable Club members list, there will be a cog icon where Club Owners and Club managers can promote/demote, and remove others  (depending on their permission level)
* In the club profile page, there will be a “join” button in the right hand panel which will send a request to the club.
* The Club chat room will send messages whenever there is an action performed updating the club status
* Activity within the club will show as news in the News panel 
Club Owners will be able to:
* Change the name of the Club and add/update the club description (or use it to message members to push push push for the top!). This can have a maximum of 400 characters including spaces and symbols.
* Add, promote, demote and remove members. 
* Toggle on/off general add requests (So if you don’t want, or don’t need any more members, then you can turn off to disable requests to join)
* Add a welcome message that will show in the chat room to all members. This can have a maximum of 100 characters including spaces and 
symbols.
Club Managers will be able to:
* Add and remove members
Club regular members
* Will have no privileges but can leave at any time

Club Naming
* Club names can have a maximum of 30 characters including spaces and symbols.
* Club names will have a “short name” option to fill in to display in the chat, this is to avoid long names cluttering the chat room and will be a maximum of 10 characters including spaces and symbols.
* * Please remember that offensive language isn’t permitted anywhere in the game, so no offensive names please or you might just find we rename you to “Rainbow Sparkles” or “The Fluffy Club” or something similar ;)

There will be 2 new additional ladders, one specifically to show your own stable members (like your friends list does now) and another to show the ranking of all Clubs. This will be worked out from the total of how well ALL members are doing in the ranking. Competition for that top place will be tough, so everyone will have to polish their hooves and ride as a team to get the best results.
Of course, if you just want to be part of a Club that just wants to play casually, that’s absolutely fine too, the choice is yours :)

Now, with this in mind, we felt it was only fair to have a completely fresh start, hence Season 2.  So all ranks will be reset (only ranks, nothing else) so that every one starts evenly. We will give rewards to the top 100 players on the final month of the Global Ladder before the fresh start of Season 2. This will also clean up the ladder displacing people that no longer play and take up valuable spots.
The top 10 will get a golden helmet, places 11 - 50 will get a silver helmet, and places 51 - 100 will get a bronze helmet. These are exclusive and cannot be obtained anywhere else, so well done to all you you that received them! :)
There will be archives of all the previous top 8 rank efforts available with all the previous monthly ranked tables, so that anyone can see them whenever they wish.

]As we know you like a challenge, all courses have been re-routed and/or redesigned and all the old high scores wiped as they are now no longer valid.  We’re looking forward to seeing the new highscores with how crazy fast some of you can ride them :D


Other Information

* XP for winning Ranked Matches has been increased to 200 from 100
* The water jump will now correctly give a penalty if you land IN the water, ON any part of the white border, OR knock the preceding rail, so beware, the water jump just got a whole heap harder!
* The friends button to open the friends list is now situated in the lower right corner of the screen
* Stable Club chat will now also open as a default chat window if you are a member of the club, where you may all chat together
* Chat windows (other than default chats) will have an exit button to close them and a minimize function
* Below the chat window there is now an additional function, “insert”. This will allow you to attach a course, a player name, or a Stable Club name into the chat
* Courses will have an “insert” button in their details beside the “play” button so that you are able to insert them into the chat. Clicking the course name there will bring up an option to be able to play it
* The cursor will change in the chat over any clickable link.
* The chat box is now resizable by using the drag point in the top right corner
* The scene will now rotate around the horse, rather than the horse just rotating in the scene.
* The horse stats panel is now situated over to the right lower corner, and will show any active buffs (roll your mouse over any showing for tooltips to explain what these are)
* Any consumable item will now have a countdown timer and show below the horses stat panel in the lower right corner
* The daily countdown timer has been redone, and is now situated in the left menu
* Rectified an issue where toggling the sound on and off only applied to the music. This should now apply to all sounds


“But what about Cross Country?” we hear you ask. 

We appreciate very much those of you that have bought the Pro Rider package to help support the game, so we thought we’d also try and do 
something too. We are going to set up a Kickstarter campaign to try and raise the remaining amount needed.
But, we need your help. To try and get the best chance possible to be able to make this feature, we need you to send us a short video clip (in English) that we can add to the campaign explaining why you think Cross country is cool, and why you would would like to have Cross Country in the game. It will go a long way into encouraging people that it will be a great feature to add :) 
These can be in MOV, MPEG, AVI, 3GP, WMV or FLV format and must not exceed 5GB in size, and yes, we’ll do one too :D 
You can send these to ridingclubteam@gmail.com as a file or a link to a download, and must be received no later than Thursday 8th December

notes.title: The “You spoke, we listened” Patch 13th October 2016
notes.content:
Hi everyone. We are really happy to see that so many are enjoying our game on Steam now as well as Facebook and Vkontakte. At the same time, we have been listening to your feedback on the things you think we should improve. While we need to make some money on the game to keep it running and to add new things to it, we agree that the previous version was too limiting. So we are doing huge changes to make the free to play experience more enjoyable. The changes will give you more playtime, you'll earn more money playing, and have better value for money on the things you buy.

Patch notes:

Energy Bar
We have doubled the amount of energy that your energy bar has from 100 to 200. 
When you level up we will add 100 energy back to your bar regardless of what you have left. ie. if you have 180 energy and level up, your bar will show 280, if you have 80 energy and level up, your bar will show 180.

Paddock
We have removed the energy needed to play in the paddock, so you can now play in there for free, for as long as you want. With this in mind we have increased the time that presents take to appear, and reduced the amount of time the lucky leaf lasts for. This will now last for 15 minutes from when used, but will make those presents and stars appear 4 times more frequently. You may also get lucky and hit something bigger now as a prize!
Your energy will also regenerate whilst playing in the paddock.

In game currency
We now have just one currency in game, gold coins. So everything that cost diamonds before, will now cost just gold coins and the prices adjusted accordingly. We have converted your old diamond and gold amounts into the new currency, making sure that you can buy more after the conversion than before.
You are now able to purchase gold coin special deals instead of diamonds should you wish to top up at any time.

Friends
We have removed Social Tickets completely from the game so you can now challenge your friends for free using no energy, this means you can keep playing as long as you want against your friends.
The rewards for Friends Challenges have been changed, the winner will now get 5 Skill tickets to go towards entry into the Weekly Showdown. 
There will no longer be diamond rewards or social ticket rewards for when a friend reaches level 10.

Match rewards (excluding Friends Challenges)
You will now get:-
Skill tickets for a win (10 for non Pro Riders, 15 for Pro Riders)
100 XP win or lose
25 gold coins win or lose

Inventory
We have removed the unnecessary shop purchase price from items in the inventory.
We have removed the unnecessary icons from gear upgrades prices
Although there are consumable items no longer available to purchase in the shop, those of you that had already purchased them, are still able to use up what you have in your inventory.

Item Upgrades
We have recalculated and lowered the costs overall of upgrading rider gear and horse gear

Shop
We have added a big apple to the shop to replace the current golden apple, this will give you a boost of 300 ap, and we have changed the golden apple to give 2000 ap for those of you who want some very serious ranked playtime. Gold apples that players had in their inventory have been exchanged for big apples.
The Riding Lesson, and the Riding Course have been removed from the shop.
The Carrot has been removed from the shop. 
The Bag of Gold and Chest of Gold have been removed from the shop
Those of you that had already purchased items no longer available in the shop, are still able to use up what you have in your inventory.


Daily Login
The daily login screen has been redesigned to show two rows of prizes:
The top row will show what non Pro Riders receive as rewards for each consecutive day and no longer just show up to day 5. There will be special prizes for days 10, 25, 75 and 50, and an extra juicy one for day 100 
The Pro Rider Spin to Win wheel has been removed, and the extra daily gifts will appear on the bottom row of the new layout making the amount of extra gifts you get now per month are even more valuable than before, with an average prize value of $15 every month

Weekly Showdown Grand Final
The rewards for all participants in the Weekly Showdown Grand Final have been adjusted to game currency, Gold Coins, (the winner will still also receive the exclusive blazer) making it even more important to qualify and do well in the Sunday Grand Final to boost that gold stash!

Course Editor
Costs have been removed from submitting your course and from choosing which scene you want your course to use. Course item costs have been adjusted

Quests
Some quest objectives have had their counter reduced, (ie, collect X stars, or X presents) and quest rewards adjusted for completion.  

Match results
Previously we only showed the match results time to .00, (hundredths of a second) We have now added an additional decimal place (.000) to show to a thousandth of a second.

Day Timer
We have added a timer to the main menu screen in the lower right corner so that you can see when your current day ends and a new one begins. This will highlight with a message to prompt you to collect your daily login rewards, and you can go straight to the daily login screen by pressing this button, so no need to log out and back in again.

Bug Fixes
Rectified the horse falling through the scene
Rectified an unknown friends challenge appearing on screen on logging in
Rectified the “Ride a clear Agility round” Steam achievement not working

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26417922/23a0680bae99dd3161941d4192136be0a12b1afc.png

notes.title: SALE - 50% off Books
notes.content:
For 24 hours, we will be having a flash sale giving  50% discount off our Books  in the shop. 
These give double the XP for every match played for 24 hours from when it's first used, so you will be able to level your horse up much faster. You don't need to use it right away, you can save it for the weekend, or when you have some time set aside to really pick up those XP points.
This will start at 18.00 GMT 29th September 2016, and end 18.00 GMT 30th September 2016

To help you convert the time so you don't miss out, we have added a link to a time zone convertor here :) https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/converter.htmlhttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26417922/e8ea8edfc9ac11cf813734f87c9aaa68d85878f9.png
